summary: Master management reporting and executive dashboarding with KPI design, variance analysis, and Power BI or Excel reporting.
lede: Management reporting and executive dashboarding give professionals who work with performance data a way to turn it into decision-ready information. The course covers defining and governing KPIs, designing executive scorecards and dashboards, and analyzing variances and exceptions. Participants also practice building management packs and writing concise commentary so finance, operations, and leadership teams can interpret performance consistently.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with performance data and need stronger control over reporting quality, dashboard design, and executive communication. It is especially relevant if you produce recurring reports, review KPIs with leadership, or need to make management information faster, cleaner, and easier to use.
modules: Executive Dashboard Design with Balanced Scorecard
prerequisites: Bring a laptop and a working spreadsheet tool such as Microsoft Excel, plus access to a sample reporting dataset if available. Familiarity with basic formulas, charts, and KPI reporting will help you get more value from the hands-on exercises.
